cases.location: Orbs all over the sky, appearing in a flash and slowly floating until disappearing

cases.long_description: My father was taking the dog outside when he saw three bright orange lights hovering in place. By the time he called me out, they had all disappeared. After watching for a moment, we saw flashes in the sky - like camera flashes, immediately followed by the appearance of more orange balls of light. This time they showed up one at a time, slowly floating upward and then flickering out like a candle hit by a gust of wind. Over and over this happened, often matching the same exact flight pattern as the previous one - but with variations in their flickering. Some faded out like a light bulb on a dimmer-switch, others simply vanished, as well as the candle thing I mentioned earlier. A few of them suddenly accelerated to incredible speeds, each taking fast turns sometimes at nearly 90 degrees. We also noticed what appeared to be man-made aircraft headed towards their location. However, the appearance of these craft were strange and drone-like. Maybe 4 or 5 of those in about 20 minutes, and well over 20 to 30 orbs in the same time frame. It’s worth noting that both me and my father were nauseous the whole time, and my girlfriend couldn’t even come outside with us because she was vomiting. All of this got better shortly after we stopped seeing the orbs. Still can’t find the cats though. I’ve had many other sightings in the past couple of months, so many that I don’t even film them anymore it’s become so common. I have videos from other sightings, just not this one. But it was certainly interesting enough to report.

cases.long_description: At a local park facing east looking over a lake, up and to the North, our left, we saw two shiny silver sphere shaped objects. One was somewhat behind and to the side of the other one. The park, Young Pine Park, is near the airport. We could see several planes during this event. It was a very clear sunny day and I could see the planes were much higher. It was evident that the objects were between us and the planes. Also, the park is not far from a landfill and there are always buzzards and other birds circling high, but it was also evident that the objects were higher than the birds.
